Liber Sententiarum Inquisitionis Tholosanae (Latin) (Philipp van Limborch (ed.), 1692)
======================================================================
The Liber Sententiarum — the Book of Sentences of the Inquisition of Toulouse, 1307-1323, as published by Limborch in 1692: the primary documentary record of early-14th-century inquisitorial sentences against Cathars and Waldensians. Latin. First-order trial source. Public domain. Sourced from Internet Archive: scan of the 1692 edition (https://archive.org/details/per_witchcraft-in-europe-and-america_historia-inquisitionis_limborch-philippus_1692_2_578).

SENTENTIARUM.
